sections.#about: A little about me Hey there! 👋 I am Hunter, from The Woodlands, Texas - just north of Houston. As a software engineer, I enjoy building applications of all kinds with people from all over the world. 👨🏻‍💻 🌍 I am a huge fan of TypeScript. The tooling is fantastic, but what really stands out about TypeScript is how it encourages me to be more mindful of the code I write. As far as frameworks go, 🥇 Svelte is always my first choice. The developer experience is excellent and it's a dream to use. Rich Harris has been a big influence on the way I think about building applications. I admire his first-principles thinking and appreciate everything he is doing to push the framework forward. The runner-up goes to 🥈 React/Next.js. Its strong community and ecosystem are something I highly value. I discovered Tailwind CSS in 2019 and have been exclusively using it ever since. In recent projects, I have been using Shadcn UI, the Tailwind-based component library and it's now one of my favorites. At the end of the day, I have a lot of respect for getting to the finish line. There's something deeply satisfying about taking an idea from concept to completion. More Although TypeScript is my language of choice, I've recently been interested in Go. In my spare time, I am either working on a project or listening to podcasts / watching videos about software development. Here are some of my favorite podcasts/channels: 🔵 Syntax 🔵 The Standup 🔵 The Primeagen 🔵 Theo Browne 🔵 Ben Davis 🔵 Matt Pocock 🔵 Notes on Work (Caleb Porzio) 🔵 Front-End Fire 🔵 Nerd Snipe 🔵 Fireship 🔵 Rich Harris (interviews) 🔵 Many more... The perfect day looks like... Programming. Building applications gives me energy. ⚡️ Reading in Spanish. Best way to improve overall comprehension. 📈 Barbecuing. Experimenting with new recipes. 🔬 Watching UFC. Enjoying pure competition. 🥊 Notes on Spanish The Spanish language has been many things to me. It has been a teacher, teaching me dedication, patience, and discipline. It has also been a vehicle for self-confidence. And after non-stop intense study, Spanish is now a part of my identity. I've spent the last 8+ years living among the Latino community, taking the opportunity to listen, learn and eventually gain a deep understanding. I've integrated many positive aspects of the Latin American lifestyle into my own life, with the most important lesson at the top of mind - Love life ❤️ Spanish Goals I was challenged to read 1 million words in Spanish to enhance my overall literacy and significantly grow my vocabulary. The complete Harry Potter series totals 1.1 million words. Challenge Accepted. 😎 ✅ Harry Potter y La Piedra Filosofal (77,325 words)✅ Harry Potter y La Camara Secreta (84,799 words)✅ Harry Potter y El Prisionero de Azkaban (106,821 words)✅ Harry Potter y El Caliz de Fuego (190,858 words)✅ Harry Potter y La Orden del Fenix (257,154 words)✅ Harry Potter y El Misterio del Principe (168,923 words)🔲 Harry Potter y Las Reliquias de la Muerte (198,227 words)

sections..featured-product: Featured Product: DataForest.io The address infrastructure Colombia needs. A focused product system: geospatial UX, data preparation, and export workflows in one working platform. dataforest.io DataForest.io A map-first address product for direct mail in Colombia. DataForest starts with a simple observation: direct mail is only useful when businesses can reach real homes in the exact places they care about. In Colombia, that address layer has historically been hard to buy, hard to verify, and hard to operationalize.I built DataForest around the map because the product is geographic at its core. Users can inspect coverage, search apartments or addresses, choose a market area, and leave with campaign-ready data instead of another spreadsheet cleanup project.Behind the interface is a focused data preparation flow: official-source Colombian address data is filtered, normalized, deduplicated, geocoded, and packaged into campaign-ready exports. 10M+ addresses in process A national data asset built for precise geographic campaigns.Map-first selection flow Users buy addresses from the same interface they use to understand coverage.CSV export workflow Campaign-ready downloads for operators who need usable data quickly. Built with TypeScript Svelte Node.js Tailwind CSS Vitest Playwright Vercel Shadcn UI Mapbox Lucia Auth Stripe

sections.#ls-section: A foundation that lasts. Launch School Core Curriculum Graduate. Mastery through first principles. 2727 Months935935 Study hours1313 Assessments Notes on Launch School Launch School was one of the hardest things I have ever done. It was also one of the most rewarding. During my time at Launch School, I learned much more than syntax and semantics, I learned attention to detail and acquired a procedural mindset. The core curriculum begins with first principles, which is by no means an attractive way to start, but it highlights the seriousness of the program. A complete understanding of the fundamentals is required before touching higher-level abstractions, and this is what makes the core curriculum so special. View curriculum ↗
